I remember you mentioning that a balanced lifestyle has been crucial in managing your chronic disease and supporting your creative goals. It's fantastic that your physical health status changed from 'Poor' to 'Good'. However, I also recall that transitioning to independent work increased stress, leading to decreased creativity and productivity. How have you been balancing these aspects?

It's great that you've found a way to manage stress and prioritize your health. Your exploratory motivation to push creative boundaries and explore new projects must be thriving in this environment. I also understand that improved physical health has sparked new ideas for your compositions, enhancing your creative process. This positivity certainly contributes to your ability to generate new ideas and innovate within your projects.
